text.p: Hibernia Corp said on Wednesday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire ArgentBank for stock, in a tax-free transaction valued at $190 million.
The deal would boost Hibernia's deposit market share in Louisiana to 20 percent, the bank said in a news release.
ArgentBank shareholders would get 2.04 Hibernia shares for each ArgentBank share they hold, in a deal that values ArgentBank at $29.07 per share.
ArgentBank shares closed Monday at 22-8/16 on the American Stock Exchange. Hibernia closed at 14-5/16 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Adding ArgentBank's current assets of $760 million would boost Hibernia's assets to $10.8 billion, with other pending mergers included, the bank said.
ArgentBank has 22 banking offices, all in Louisiana.
